national_questions.qe: The economic measures announced by the US President against Iran targeted which of the following sectors?
national_questions.qh: अमेरिकी राष्ट्रपति द्वारा ईरान के खिलाफ घोषित आर्थिक उपायों ने किन क्षेत्रों को लक्षित किया?
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because the announcement covered oil‑smuggling networks, financial transfers, exchange houses, ship registries and front companies.
• Option A is Incorrect as it represents only one component of the broader package.
• Option B is Incorrect for the same reason – it is a subset.
• Option C is Incorrect because it is also a subset of the comprehensive measures.

national_questions.qe: Which Union Minister chaired the 31st Southern Zonal Council meeting held in Mahabalipuram?
national_questions.qh: महाबलीपुरम में आयोजित 31वें दक्षिणी ज़ोनल काउंसिल बैठक की अध्यक्षता किस केंद्रीय मंत्री ने की?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because Union Home and Cooperation Minister Amit Shah chaired the 31st Southern Zonal Council meeting.
• Option A is Incorrect; Rajnath Singh is the Defence Minister.
• Option C is Incorrect; Nirmala Sitharaman is the Finance Minister.
• Option D is Incorrect; Piyush Goyal is the Commerce & Industry Minister.

national_questions.qe: Which sector was NOT part of the agenda of the 4th India‑Singapore Ministerial Roundtable held in Singapore?
national_questions.qh: सिंगापुर में आयोजित 4थी भारत‑सिंगापुर मंत्रीस्तरीय गोलमेज़ में निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा क्षेत्र एजेंडा में नहीं था?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the roundtable focused on advanced manufacturing, connectivity, digitalisation, healthcare, skills development and sustainability, but did not discuss space exploration.
• Option A is Incorrect; advanced manufacturing was a key agenda item.
• Option B is Incorrect; connectivity was explicitly discussed.
• Option D is Incorrect; digitalisation featured prominently in the discussions.

national_questions.qe: Under which national master plan were the four multi‑tracking railway projects approved by the Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs?
national_questions.qh: कैबिनेट कमिटी ऑन इकोनॉमिक अफेयर्स द्वारा स्वीकृत चार मल्टी‑ट्रैकिंग रेलवे परियोजनाएँ किस राष्ट्रीय मास्टर प्लान के अंतर्गत हैं?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the projects were approved under the PM‑Gati Shakti National Master Plan, aiming to boost freight capacity and slated for completion by 2030‑31.
• Option B is Incorrect because the National Infrastructure Pipeline is a broader funding framework, not the specific master plan for these railway projects.
• Option C is Incorrect because Bharatmala Pariyojana pertains to road highways, not railway multi‑tracking.
• Option D is Incorrect because Sagarmala focuses on port‑linked development, unrelated to the railway initiative.

national_questions.qe: What is the estimated total value of the tunnel tenders announced by the Ministry of Road Transport and Highways for 2026?
national_questions.qh: 2026 में सड़क परिवहन एवं राजमार्ग मंत्रालय द्वारा घोषित टनल टेंडर का अनुमानित कुल मूल्य क्या है?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the ministry disclosed tunnel tenders worth approximately Rs 2 to 2.5 lakh crore, focusing on advanced TBM and precast technologies for Himalayan terrains.
• Option A is Incorrect as the announced value is higher than Rs 1‑1.5 lakh crore.
• Option C is Incorrect because the figure exceeds the stated Rs 2‑2.5 lakh crore range.
• Option D is Incorrect as the amount is far above the announced tender valuation.

national_questions.qe: Which free trade agreement is India's largest individual export market as of FY 2024-25?
national_questions.qh: कौन सा मुक्त व्यापार समझौता FY 2024-25 में भारत का सबसे बड़ा व्यक्तिगत निर्यात बाजार है?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the India‑UAE CEPA, effective from May 1 2022, has become India’s largest individual FTA export market, with bilateral trade crossing US$ 100 billion in FY 2024‑25.
• Option B is Incorrect because the India‑Australia CEPA, while important, accounts for a smaller share of exports.
• Option C is Incorrect because the India‑Japan partnership does not rank as the top export market.
• Option D is Incorrect because the India‑UK agreement is newer and has a lower export volume.

national_questions.qe: Under which national master plan are the four railway multi‑tracking projects approved for completion by 2030‑31?
national_questions.qh: कौन सी राष्ट्रीय मास्टर योजना के तहत चार रेलवे मल्टी‑ट्रैकिंग परियोजनाओं को 2030‑31 तक पूरा करने के लिए मंजूरी दी गई है?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs approved the projects under the PM‑Gati Shakti National Master Plan, targeting completion by 2030‑31.
• Option A is Incorrect; the National Infrastructure Pipeline is a broader funding framework, not the specific plan cited.
• Option C is Incorrect; Bharatmala focuses on highways, not railways.
• Option D is Incorrect; Sagarmala pertains to port‑linked development.

national_questions.qe: The transshipment cargo reform at Delhi Airport reduced the average end‑to‑end transit time to how many hours?
national_questions.qh: दिल्ली हवाई अड्डे पर ट्रांसशिपमेंट कार्गो सुधार ने औसत अंत‑से‑अंत ट्रांज़िट समय को कितने घंटे तक घटाया?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the reform eliminated mandatory re‑screening, cutting the average transit time from 60 hours to 20 hours.
• Option A is Incorrect; 30 hours is higher than the achieved figure.
• Option B is Incorrect; 45 hours does not reflect the reported reduction.
• Option D is Incorrect; 60 hours was the pre‑reform duration.

national_questions.qe: What proportion of investment in the Research, Development and Innovation (RDI) Fund is expected to come from private equity sources?
national_questions.qh: रिसर्च, डेवलपमेंट और इनोवेशन (RDI) फंड में निजी इक्विटी स्रोतों से निवेश का कितना प्रतिशत अपेक्षित है?
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because the RDI Fund model anticipates that private equity will contribute 50 percent of the total investment.
• Option A is Incorrect; the policy does not limit private equity to a quarter of the fund.
• Option B is Incorrect; 75 percent exceeds the stipulated share.
• Option C is Incorrect; the fund also involves substantial public capital, not solely private equity.

national_questions.qe: Which ministry is preparing tunnel tenders worth up to Rs 2.5 lakh crore focusing on advanced tunnelling technologies?
national_questions.qh: कौन सा मंत्रालय उन्नत टनलिंग तकनीकों पर केंद्रित, अधिकतम 2.5 लाख करोड़ रुपये के टनल टेंडर तैयार कर रहा है?
oe: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways
Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
oh: गृह एवं शहरी मामलों का मंत्रालय
national_questions.e: • Option A is Correct because the tunnel tenders worth Rs 2‑2.5 lakh crore were announced by the Ministry of Road Transport and Highways under Minister Nitin Gadkari. • Option B is Incorrect because the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs deals with urban infrastructure, not national tunnel projects. • Option C is Incorrect because the Railways ministry handles railway tunnels, not the broad road‑tunnel programme. • Option D is Incorrect because the Power ministry is unrelated to tunnel construction.

national_questions.qe: Under which Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement did the UAE become India’s largest individual FTA export market in FY 2025‑26?
national_questions.qh: किस व्यापक आर्थिक साझेदारी समझौते (CEPA) के तहत यूएई FY 2025‑26 में भारत का सबसे बड़ा व्यक्तिगत FTA निर्यात बाजार बन गया?
national_questions.e: • Option B is Correct because the India‑UAE Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement, operational since May 2022, made the UAE the top FTA export destination in FY 2025‑26. • Option A is Incorrect as the India‑Saudi Arabia CEPA was signed later and did not top the 2025‑26 export list. • Option C is Incorrect because the India‑Australia CEPA does not account for the UAE’s export share. • Option D is Incorrect since the India‑UK FTA is unrelated to the UAE market share.

national_questions.qe: Which organization will coordinate the month‑long youth financial inclusion campaign announced by the Finance Minister for October 2026?
national_questions.qh: वित्त मंत्री द्वारा अक्टूबर 2026 में शुरू किए जाने वाले एक महीने के युवा वित्तीय समावेशन अभियान का समन्वय कौन सा संगठन करेगा?
oe: Securities and Exchange Board of India
oh: सिक्योरिटीज़ एंड एक्सचेंज बोर्ड ऑफ़ इंडिया
national_questions.e: • Option C is Correct because the campaign will be coordinated through the Indian Banks' Association via a common online portal and physical outreach. • Option A is Incorrect; the RBI regulates banks but is not the nodal agency for this outreach. • Option B is Incorrect; SEBI oversees securities markets, not financial inclusion drives. • Option D is Incorrect; NPCI handles digital payments, not the broader campaign coordination.

national_questions.qe: The Supreme Court asked the Ministry of Education to file an affidavit on the implementation of recommendations of which committee concerning the National Testing Agency?
national_questions.qh: सुप्रीम कोर्ट ने राष्ट्रीय परीक्षण एजेंसी (NTA) से संबंधित सिफ़ारिशों के कार्यान्वयन पर मंत्रालय को अफ़िडेविट दाखिल करने के लिए किस समिति की सिफ़ारिशों का उल्लेख किया?
national_questions.e: • Option D is Correct because the Court specifically referred to the K. Radhakrishnan Committee’s 101 recommendations on overhauling public examinations and NTA infrastructure. • Option A is Incorrect; the Nilekani Committee dealt with digital education reforms, not the NTA recommendations. • Option B is Incorrect; there is no K. S. Rao Committee linked to this matter. • Option C is Incorrect; the Raghavan Committee’s remit was unrelated to NEET‑UG or NTA reforms.

national_questions.qe: What percentage of India's railway network has been electrified as reported by Union I&B Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw at the UP‑Japan Investment Summit 2026?
national_questions.qh: यूपी‑जापान निवेश शिखर सम्मेलन 2026 में केंद्रीय सूचना एवं प्रौद्योगिकी मंत्री अश्विनी वैष्णव द्वारा रिपोर्ट किए अनुसार भारत के रेलवे नेटवर्क का कितने प्रतिशत भाग विद्युतीकृत हो चुका है?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the minister stated that 99.6 % of the railway network is electrified.
• Option A is Incorrect because the electrification level is higher than 95 %.
• Option C is Incorrect as the reported figure is 99.6 %, not 98 %.
• Option D is Incorrect because electrification is not yet complete (100 %).

national_questions.qe: Which Free Trade Agreement accounted for the highest merchandise export value for India in FY 2025‑26?
national_questions.qh: वित्तीय वर्ष 2025‑26 में भारत के वस्तु निर्यात में सबसे अधिक मूल्य वाला मुक्त व्यापार समझौता कौन सा था?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the India‑UAE CEPA generated US$ 37,359.11 million in merchandise exports, the highest among all FTAs in FY 2025‑26.
• Option B is Incorrect; the India‑UK FTA did not surpass the UAE CEPA in export value.
• Option C is Incorrect; the India‑Australia FTA contributed less than the UAE CEPA.
• Option D is Incorrect; the India‑Japan CEPA’s export value was lower than that of the UAE CEPA.

national_questions.qe: On which date did the month‑long youth banking campaign, announced by Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman, commence?
national_questions.qh: वित्त मंत्री निर्मला सीतारमन द्वारा घोषित युवा बैंकिंग अभियान का प्रारम्भिक दिनांक कौन सा है?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the campaign was launched on 2 October 2026, coinciding with the birth anniversary of Mahatma Gandhi.
• Option A is Incorrect; 15 August is Independence Day, not the campaign start date.
• Option B is Incorrect; the campaign began in October, not January 2027.
• Option D is Incorrect; 26 January is Republic Day, unrelated to the youth banking initiative.

national_questions.qe: Which organization is the nodal agency for the month‑long youth banking campaign announced by the Finance Minister in October 2026?
national_questions.qh: वित्त मंत्री द्वारा अक्टूबर 2026 में घोषित एक महीने की युवा बैंकिंग अभियान के लिए कौन‑सा संगठन मुख्य एजेंसी है?
oe: Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the Finance Minister announced that the campaign will be implemented through the Indian Banks' Association, providing a common online portal for banking, skilling and entrepreneurship.
• Option B is Incorrect; RBI is the regulator but not the nodal agency for this outreach.
• Option C is Incorrect; DFS organised the PSB Confluence but the campaign execution is assigned to IBA.
• Option D is Incorrect; the Ministry of Youth Affairs is not mentioned in the announcement.

national_questions.qe: Which ministry approved the Incentive Scheme for Promotion of Domestic PNG Connections?
national_questions.qh: घरेलू पीएनजी कनेक्शन को बढ़ावा देने के लिए प्रोत्साहन योजना किस मंत्रालय ने मंजूर की?
oe: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
oh: गृह एवं शहरी मामलों का मंत्रालय
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the scheme was approved by the Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas to fast‑track piped natural gas connections.
• Option A is Incorrect; the Power Ministry deals with electricity, not PNG incentives.
• Option C is Incorrect; housing ministry is unrelated to gas distribution.
• Option D is Incorrect; rural development ministry is not the approving authority for this scheme.

national_questions.qe: Which Free Trade Agreement emerged as India's largest individual FTA export market, crossing US$100 billion in bilateral trade within three years?
national_questions.qh: कौन‑सा मुक्त व्यापार समझौता भारत के सबसे बड़े व्यक्तिगत एफटीए निर्यात बाजार के रूप में उभरा, जिसने तीन वर्षों में द्विपक्षीय व्यापार में 100 अर्ब डॉलर पार कर लिये?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the India‑UAE CEPA, effective from 1 May 2022, became the largest FTA export market, crossing US$100 billion in bilateral trade within three years.
• Option A is Incorrect; the India‑Australia CEPA has not reached the US$100 billion milestone.
• Option B is Incorrect; the India‑UK FTA is newer and trade volume is lower.
• Option D is Incorrect; the India‑Japan CEPA also falls short of the stated trade value.

national_questions.qe: The 'Shakti Ki Saptadhara' roadmap translates the Independence Day vision of which Indian Prime Minister into action?
national_questions.qh: 'शक्ति की सप्तधारा' रोडमैप भारत के किस प्रधानमंत्री की स्वतंत्रता दिवस की दृष्टि को कार्यान्वित करता है?
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because the programme implements Prime Minister Narendra Modi's Independence Day roadmap for agriculture, food processing and rural empowerment.
• Option A is Incorrect; although Modi is the Prime Minister, the question asks which PM's vision is being translated – the answer is his vision, not his name listed as an option.
• Option B is Incorrect; Amit Shah is the Home Minister, not the originator of the roadmap.
• Option C is Incorrect; Rajnath Singh is the Defence Minister, unrelated to this scheme.
• Option D correctly identifies the Prime Minister whose vision is being operationalised.

national_questions.qe: Under which FTA did India record its largest individual export market in FY 2025‑26?
national_questions.qh: किस मुक्त व्यापार समझौते के तहत भारत ने FY 2025‑26 में अपना सबसे बड़ा व्यक्तिगत निर्यात बाजार दर्ज किया?
oh: भारत‑संयुक्त अरब अमीरात व्यापक आर्थिक साझेदारी समझौता (CEPA)
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the India‑UAE CEPA, effective from 1 May 2022, emerged as the largest individual FTA export market with US$ 37,359.11 million in FY 2025‑26.
• Option A is Incorrect; the India‑UK FTA does not hold the top export position.
• Option C is Incorrect; the India‑Australia FTA’s export figures are lower.
• Option D is Incorrect; the India‑Japan CEPA is not the leading export market for the cited period.

national_questions.qe: Which organization will coordinate the month‑long youth banking campaign announced by Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman?
national_questions.qh: वित्त मंत्री निर्मला सीतारमन द्वारा घोषित एक महीने के युवा बैंकिंग अभियान का समन्वय कौन सा संगठन करेगा?
oe: Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI)
oh: सिक्योरिटीज़ एंड एक्सचेंज बोर्ड ऑफ़ इंडिया (SEBI)
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the Indian Banks' Association is envisaged to provide a common online portal and coordinate the campaign.
• Option A is Incorrect; RBI is the regulator but not designated as the campaign coordinator.
• Option B is Incorrect; NPCI handles payment infrastructure, not the broader banking‑skilling portal.
• Option D is Incorrect; SEBI regulates securities markets, unrelated to the youth banking drive.

national_questions.qe: Which Indian regiment primarily represented India in the MAITREE‑XV joint military exercise with Thailand in August 2026?
national_questions.qh: अगस्त 2026 में थाईलैंड के साथ MAITREE‑XV संयुक्त सैन्य अभ्यास में भारत का प्रमुख प्रतिनिधित्व करने वाला भारतीय रेजिमेंट कौन सा था?
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because the 9 Gorkha Rifles formed the core Indian contingent in MAITREE‑XV.
• Option A is Incorrect; 1 Para (SF) did not constitute the primary Indian unit for this exercise.
• Option B is Incorrect; 2 Rajputana Rifles were not mentioned as the lead regiment.
• Option C is Incorrect; 3 Sikh Regiment was not the designated representative.

national_questions.qe: Which European mechanism creates a double‑compliance burden for Indian exporters under the India‑EU Free Trade Agreement?
national_questions.qh: भारत‑EU मुक्त व्यापार समझौते के तहत भारतीय निर्यातकों के लिए दोहरी अनुपालन बोझ उत्पन्न करने वाला यूरोपीय तंत्र कौन‑सा है?
oh: EU का कार्बन बॉर्डर एडजस्टमेंट मैकेनिज़्म (CBAM)
EU का जनरल डेटा प्रोटेक्शन रेगुलेशन (GDPR)
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the EU's CBAM, entering its definitive financial phase, requires Indian exporters to account for carbon costs separately from domestic regulations, creating a double‑compliance burden under the India‑EU FTA.
• Option B is Incorrect; GDPR deals with data privacy, not trade‑related carbon costs.
• Option C is Incorrect; the Digital Services Act regulates online platforms, not export carbon compliance.
• Option D is Incorrect; anti‑dumping duties relate to price protection, not carbon border adjustments.

national_questions.qe: Which train‑collision‑avoidance system will be installed on the newly approved Qadian‑Beas railway line?
national_questions.qh: नए अनुमोदित क़ादियन‑बीस रेलवे लाइन पर कौन‑सा ट्रेन टकराव रोकथाम प्रणाली स्थापित की जाएगी?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the project details specifically mention deployment of the indigenous Kavach train‑collision‑avoidance system.
• Option A is Incorrect; ETCS is a European signalling standard not cited for this project.
• Option C is Incorrect; TPWS is used in some countries but not listed for this line.
• Option D is Incorrect; ATC is a generic term and not the system named in the approval.

national_questions.qe: Which UAV model is being leased by the Indian Navy under the Rs 1,943 crore contract signed by the Ministry of Defence?
national_questions.qh: किस UAV मॉडल को भारत के रक्षा मंत्रालय द्वारा हस्ताक्षरित ₹ 1,943 करोड़ के अनुबंध के तहत भारतीय नौसेना द्वारा लीज़ पर लिया गया है?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the MoD signed a lease agreement with General Atomics for two MQ‑9B Sea Guardian HALE RPAS for the Indian Navy.
• Option A is Incorrect; the Gray Eagle is a different UAV not mentioned in this deal.
• Option B is Incorrect; Heron TP is an Israeli UAV, not part of this contract.
• Option D is Incorrect; the Global Hawk is a US high‑altitude ISR platform, not the leased model.

national_questions.qe: Who presided over the 12th BRICS Environment Ministers' Meeting held at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi?
national_questions.qh: भारत में आयोजित 12वें ब्रिक्स पर्यावरण मंत्रियों की बैठक की अध्यक्षता किसने की?
oe: Union Minister for Environment, Forest and Climate Change Bhupender Yadav
Union Minister for Information and Broadcasting Prakash Javadekar
Union Minister for Home Affairs Rajnath Singh
Union Minister for Road Transport and Highways Nitin Gadkari
oh: पर्यावरण, वन और जलवायु परिवर्तन के केंद्रीय मंत्री भूपेंद्र यादव
सूचना एवं प्रसारण के केंद्रीय मंत्री प्रकाश जावड़ेकर
गृह मामलों के केंद्रीय मंत्री राजनाथ सिंह
राज्य सड़क एवं राजमार्ग के केंद्रीय मंत्री नितिन गडकरी
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because Bhupender Yadav, the Union Minister for Environment, Forest and Climate Change, chaired the 12th BRICS Environment Ministers' Meeting at Bharat Mandapam on the stated date.
• Option B is Incorrect because Prakash Javadekar heads the Information & Broadcasting Ministry, not the environment portfolio.
• Option C is Incorrect because Rajnath Singh is the Home Minister, not related to the BRICS environment meeting.
• Option D is Incorrect because Nitin Gadkari is the Road Transport & Highways Minister and had no role in chairing this meeting.

national_questions.qe: Which of the following was NOT a member category of the Supreme Court‑constituted committee to probe the Delhi student protests?
national_questions.qh: दिल्ली छात्र विरोध की जांच के लिए सुप्रीम कोर्ट द्वारा गठित समिति में निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा सदस्य वर्ग नहीं था?
oe: Ex‑Director of the Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI)
oh: सत्र में रहने वाले केंद्रीय मंत्री
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because the committee comprised retired judges, a former DGP and an ex‑CBI director; no serving Union Minister was part of it.
• Option A is Incorrect because retired Supreme Court judges were explicitly mentioned as members.
• Option B is Incorrect because a former DGP was included in the high‑powered panel.
• Option C is Incorrect because an ex‑CBI director was also part of the committee.

national_questions.qe: In which year did the EU's Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism enter its definitive financial phase, coinciding with the conclusion of India‑EU FTA negotiations?
national_questions.qh: EU के कार्बन बॉर्डर एडेप्टेशन मेकैनिज़्म ने अपने निश्चित वित्तीय चरण में प्रवेश कब किया, जो भारत‑EU मुक्त व्यापार समझौते की बातचीत के समापन के साथ हुआ?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the definitive financial phase of the EU CBAM began in 2026, the same month when India and the EU concluded their FTA negotiations.
• Option A is Incorrect because 2024 predates the reported timeline.
• Option B is Incorrect because the CBAM was still in its transitional phase in 2025.
• Option D is Incorrect because the definitive phase had already started by 2026.

national_questions.qe: What is the lease period for the two MQ‑9B Sea Guardian drones signed by the Ministry of Defence on 17 August 2026?
national_questions.qh: 17 अगस्त 2026 को रक्षा मंत्रालय द्वारा दो MQ‑9B सी गार्डियन ड्रोन के लीज़ समझौते की अवधि क्या है?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the contract specifies a 30‑month lease for the two MQ‑9B Sea Guardian HALE RPAS.
• Option A is Incorrect as the lease is longer than one year.
• Option C is Incorrect because the agreement is not for 24 months.
• Option D is Incorrect because the lease does not extend to three years.

national_questions.qe: Which ministry notified the sixth Positive Indigenisation List comprising 405 strategically important items?
national_questions.qh: कौन सा मंत्रालय 405 रणनीतिक वस्तुओं की छठी सकारात्मक स्वदेशीकरण सूची जारी किया?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the Ministry of Defence notified the sixth Positive Indigenisation List with 405 items, including 16 for the Indian Coast Guard and 389 for DPSUs, to boost self‑reliance under Aatmanirbhar Bharat.
• Option B is Incorrect because the Commerce Ministry did not issue this list.
• Option C is Incorrect because the External Affairs Ministry is unrelated to defence indigenisation.
• Option D is Incorrect because the Home Ministry handles internal security, not defence procurement.

national_questions.qe: In which year did India and the European Union conclude negotiations for a Free Trade Agreement that coincided with the EU's Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism entering its definitive financial phase?
national_questions.qh: किस वर्ष भारत और यूरोपीय संघ ने मुक्त व्यापार समझौते की वार्ता समाप्त की, जो यूरोपीय संघ के कार्बन बॉर्डर एडेजस्टमेंट मैकेनिज़्म के वित्तीय चरण में प्रवेश के साथ हुई?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because negotiations for the India‑EU FTA were concluded in January 2026, the same month the EU’s CBAM entered its definitive financial phase.
• Option A is Incorrect; no such conclusion occurred in 2024.
• Option B is Incorrect; the agreement was not finalized in 2025.
• Option D is Incorrect; 2027 is after the actual conclusion date.

national_questions.qe: Which company did the Ministry of Defence sign a contract with to lease two MQ‑9B Sea Guardian drones for the Indian Navy?
national_questions.qh: भारतीय नौसेना के लिए दो MQ‑9B सी गार्डियन ड्रोन लीज़ करने हेतु रक्षा मंत्रालय ने किस कंपनी के साथ अनुबंध किया?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the MoD signed a Rs 1,943 crore contract with General Atomics Aeronautical Systems, Inc. to lease two MQ‑9B Sea Guardian HALE RPAS for the Indian Navy.
• Option A is Incorrect; Boeing was not the vendor.
• Option C is Incorrect; Lockheed Martin was not involved.
• Option D is Incorrect; Airbus did not supply these drones.

national_questions.qe: What is the approved estimated cost (in crore rupees) for the Qadian‑Beas broad gauge railway line project in Punjab?
national_questions.qh: पंजाब में क़ादियन‑बीस ब्रॉड गैज रेलवे लाइन परियोजना के लिए अनुमोदित अनुमानित लागत (करोड़ रुपये में) क्या है?
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because the Centre approved a detailed estimate of ₹1,419.05 crore for the 39.68 km Qadian‑Beas railway line, which will include two crossing stations, 11 major bridges, 121 minor bridges, 54 RUBs and the indigenous Kavach collision‑avoidance system.
• Option A is Incorrect; the cost is higher than 1,200 crore.
• Option B is Incorrect; 1,300 crore is not the approved figure.
• Option C is Incorrect; 1,500 crore exceeds the sanctioned amount.

national_questions.qe: Which Indian agency led the multi‑state operation that busted the ISI‑backed Shahzad Bhatti Network in August 2026?
national_questions.qh: अगस्त 2026 में आईएसआई‑समर्थित शाहज़ाद भट्टी नेटवर्क को ध्वस्त करने वाले बहु‑राज्य ऑपरेशन का नेतृत्व कौन सी भारतीय एजेंसी ने किया?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the National Investigation Agency (NIA) coordinated the large‑scale anti‑terror operation across 14 states, leading to 253 arrests and seizure of IEDs and grenades.
• Option A is Incorrect because the CBI handles economic crimes and corruption, not counter‑terror operations of this nature.
• Option C is Incorrect because the IB focuses on internal security intelligence, but the operational arrests were executed by NIA.
• Option D is Incorrect because RAW conducts external intelligence; the crackdown was a domestic law‑enforcement action.

national_questions.qe: The India‑EU Free Trade Agreement concluded in January 2026 coincided with the EU entering the definitive phase of which mechanism?
national_questions.qh: जनवरी 2026 में समाप्त हुए भारत‑EU मुक्त व्यापार समझौते के साथ यूरोपीय संघ ने किस तंत्र के निर्णायक चरण में प्रवेश किया?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the EU’s Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) entered its definitive financial phase in early 2026, exactly when the India‑EU FTA negotiations were concluded.
• Option A is Incorrect; the ETS is an existing market‑based scheme and did not start a new definitive phase in 2026.
• Option C is Incorrect; SFDR relates to sustainability disclosures, not a border‑adjustment mechanism.
• Option D is Incorrect; the European Green Deal is a broad policy framework, not a specific mechanism entering a definitive phase.

national_questions.qe: What is the length of the newly approved Qadian‑Beas broad gauge railway line in Punjab?
national_questions.qh: पंजाब में नई स्वीकृत क़ादियन‑बीस ब्रॉड‑गेज रेलवे लाइन की लंबाई कितनी है?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the Ministry of Railways approved a detailed estimate for a 39.68 km Qadian‑Beas line under the Socially Desirable Rail Connectivity Programme.
• Option B is Incorrect; 45.12 km does not match the official project length.
• Option C is Incorrect; 52.50 km exceeds the sanctioned stretch.
• Option D is Incorrect; 60 km is unrelated to the approved project.

national_questions.qe: Which ministry approved the detailed estimate of ₹1,419.05 crore for the 39.68 km Qadian‑Beas broad gauge railway line?
national_questions.qh: कौन से मंत्रालय ने क़ादियन‑बीस 39.68 किमी ब्रॉड गैज रेलवे लाइन के लिए ₹1,419.05 करोड़ का विस्तृत अनुमान मंजूर किया?
oe: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the project is a railway line and the detailed estimate was approved by the Ministry of Railways under the Socially Desirable Rail Connectivity Programme.
• Option B is Incorrect because the Road Transport Ministry deals with highways, not railway projects.
• Option C is Incorrect because the Finance Ministry provides funding but does not approve detailed railway project estimates.
• Option D is Incorrect because the Home Ministry is not involved in railway infrastructure approvals.

national_questions.qe: The High‑powered Committee on Banking Reforms for Viksit Bharat was announced by which ministry?
national_questions.qh: विकसित भारत के लिए बैंकिंग सुधारों पर हाई‑पावर कमेटी की घोषणा किस मंत्रालय ने की?
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because the announcement was made by Union Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman and the committee will be constituted under the Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance.
• Option A is Incorrect as the Commerce Ministry did not announce the banking reforms committee.
• Option B is Incorrect because corporate affairs are unrelated to banking reform committees.
• Option C is Incorrect since the Law Ministry was not the announcing authority.

national_questions.qe: Arrests in the multi‑state crackdown on the ISI‑backed Shahzad Bhatti Network were booked under which act?
national_questions.qh: आईएसआई‑समर्थित शहजाद भट्टी नेटवर्क पर बहु‑राज्य कार्रवाई में गिरफ़्तार किए गए लोगों के खिलाफ किस अधिनियम के तहत मामला दर्ज किया गया?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the operatives were charged under the Unlawful Activities (Prevention) Act (UAPA), which is used for terrorism‑related offences.
• Option A is Incorrect as the Arms Act deals with illegal possession of weapons, not the primary terrorism charge.
• Option B is Incorrect because the National Security Act is for preventive detention, not the specific charge mentioned.
• Option D is Incorrect; the Prevention of Terrorism Act is not the legislation cited in the reports.

national_questions.qe: India’s lease of two MQ‑9B Sea Guardian drones for the Navy was signed with which company?
national_questions.qh: भारतीय नौसेना के लिए दो MQ‑9B सी गार्डियन ड्रोन के लीज़ समझौते पर किस कंपनी के साथ हस्ताक्षर किए गए?
oe: Lease agreement with General Atomics Aeronautical Systems
Lease agreement with Israel Aerospace Industries
oh: जनरल एटॉमिक्स एरोनॉटिकल सिस्टम्स के साथ लीज़ समझौता
इज़राइल एयरोस्पेस इंडस्ट्रीज के साथ लीज़ समझौता
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the Ministry of Defence signed a ₹1,943 crore lease contract with General Atomics Aeronautical Systems (GA‑ASI) for two MQ‑9B Sea Guardian HALE RPAS.
• Option A is Incorrect; Boeing was not the vendor for this HALE drone.
• Option C is Incorrect; Israel Aerospace Industries was not involved in this specific lease.
• Option D is Incorrect because the drones were not procured from the domestic DRDO programme.

national_questions.qe: Which Union Territory became the first to commence digital self‑enumeration for Census 2027?
national_questions.qh: कौन सा केंद्र शासित प्रदेश 2027 जनगणना के लिए डिजिटल स्व-गणना शुरू करने वाला पहला केंद्र शासित प्रदेश बना?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because Ladakh launched the digital self‑enumeration phase (17‑31 August 2027) for Census 2027, becoming the first UT to do so, with 637 enumeration blocks covering the region.
• Option B is Incorrect because Jammu & Kashmir has not started digital self‑enumeration for Census 2027.
• Option C is Incorrect because Delhi, though a UT, did not commence the self‑enumeration phase first.
• Option D is Incorrect because Chandigarh is a Union Territory but not the pioneer in this exercise.

national_questions.qe: The customs duty exemption claimed by importers of areca nuts was based on which international agreement?
national_questions.qh: अंजीर के आयातकों द्वारा दावा किया गया कस्टम ड्यूटी छूट किस अंतरराष्ट्रीय समझौते पर आधारित था?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the syndicate falsely declared Bangladesh as the origin to claim 100 % duty exemption under the South Asian Free Trade Area (SAFTA) rules, leading to a loss of over ₹2,500 crore.
• Option A is Incorrect because SAFTA is the agreement that was misused, not the correct basis for exemption.
• Option C is Incorrect because WTO provisions do not provide a blanket 100 % exemption for areca nuts.
• Option D is Incorrect because RCEP is unrelated to the Indian‑Bangladesh trade route used in this fraud.

national_questions.qe: Who presided over the 12th BRICS Environment Ministers Meeting held in New Delhi in 2026?
national_questions.qh: 2026 में नई दिल्ली में आयोजित 12वें ब्रिक्स पर्यावरण मंत्रियों की बैठक की अध्यक्षता किसने की?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the Union Minister for Environment, Forest and Climate Change, Bhupender Yadav, chaired the 12th BRICS Environment Ministers Meeting in New Delhi under India’s 2026 BRICS chairmanship.
• Option A is Incorrect because Prakash Javadekar is the Minister of Information & Broadcasting, not the environment minister.
• Option C is Incorrect because Rajendra Singh is a senior IAS officer, not a Union minister.
• Option D is Incorrect because Hardeep Singh Puri handles Housing and Urban Affairs, not the environment portfolio.

national_questions.qe: What is the special reference date adopted for the Census 2027 self‑enumeration in Ladakh?
national_questions.qh: लद्दाख में जनगणना 2027 की स्व-गणना के लिए अपनाई गई विशेष संदर्भ तिथि क्या है?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because Ladakh, facing harsh winter conditions, fixed 1 September as the special reference date for its Census 2027 enumeration.
• Option B is Incorrect; 31 August is the end date of the self‑enumeration phase, not the reference date.
• Option C is Incorrect; 15 August has no relevance to the census schedule.
• Option D is Incorrect; 1 August is not mentioned in the census plan.

national_questions.qe: In which year was the Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana (PMVBRY) launched?
national_questions.qh: प्रधानमंत्री विकसित भारत रोजगार योजना (PMVBRY) किस वर्ष लॉन्च की गई थी?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the PMVBRY scheme was launched in 2026 to provide skill‑development training and job placement for youth across India.
• Option A is Incorrect; 2024 predates the scheme’s announcement.
• Option B is Incorrect; 2025 is the year before the actual launch.
• Option D is Incorrect; 2027 is after the launch year.

national_questions.qe: Under the Pradhan Mantri Anusuchit Jaati Abhyuday Yojana (PM‑AJAY), what is the maximum financial assistance provided per eligible family for education and skill training?
national_questions.qh: प्रधान मंत्री अनुसूचित जाति अभ्युदय योजना (PM‑AJAY) के तहत प्रत्येक पात्र परिवार को शिक्षा व कौशल प्रशिक्षण के लिये अधिकतम कितनी वित्तीय सहायता दी जाती है?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because PM‑AJAY offers up to ₹1.5 lakh per family for education and skill‑training as announced in the scheme details.
• Option A is Incorrect – the scheme’s ceiling is higher than ₹1 lakh.
• Option C is Incorrect – ₹2 lakh exceeds the stipulated limit.
• Option D is Incorrect – ₹2.5 lakh is not provided under PM‑AJAY.

national_questions.qe: What was the total foreign portfolio investment (FPI) inflow into Indian equities during the first two weeks of August 2026?
national_questions.qh: अगस्त 2026 के पहले दो हफ्तों में भारतीय इक्विटीज़ में विदेशी पोर्टफोलियो निवेश (FPI) का कुल प्रवाह कितना था?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because reports state FPIs invested a net ₹16,621 crore in Indian equities in the first two weeks of August 2026.
• Option B is Incorrect – the figure is lower than the reported amount.
• Option C is Incorrect – the amount exceeds the actual inflow.
• Option D is Incorrect – the amount is far above the reported figure.

national_questions.qe: In which year will India chair the BRICS and host the 12th BRICS Environment Ministers Meeting in New Delhi?
national_questions.qh: भारत किस वर्ष में ब्रिक्स की अध्यक्षता करेगा और नई दिल्ली में 12वाँ ब्रिक्स पर्यावरण मंत्रियों की बैठक आयोजित करेगा?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because India’s BRICS chairmanship is for the year 2026, under which the 12th BRICS Environment Ministers Meeting will be held in New Delhi.
• Option A is Incorrect – the chairmanship is not in 2025.
• Option B is Incorrect – 2027 is after India’s term.
• Option D is Incorrect – 2028 falls outside the current chairmanship period.

national_questions.qe: Which two states were placed under the IMD's red colour warning for very heavy rainfall in August 2026?
national_questions.qh: अगस्त 2026 में अत्यधिक वर्षा के लिये IMD ने किन दो राज्यों को लाल चेतावनी (रेड) जारी की?
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because the IMD issued a red colour warning for very heavy rainfall over Odisha and West Bengal.
• Option A is Incorrect – those states received only orange alerts, not red.
• Option B is Incorrect – those states were under orange alerts.
• Option C is Incorrect – those states were also under orange alerts, not red.

national_questions.qe: Which Union Territory will become the first to complete the Census 2027 exercise through self‑enumeration?
national_questions.qh: कौन सा केंद्र शासित प्रदेश स्व-गणना के माध्यम से जनगणना 2027 को पूरा करने वाला पहला केंद्र शासित प्रदेश बनेगा?
national_questions.e:
• Option C (Ladakh) is Correct because the Self‑Enumeration for Census 2027 is scheduled from 17‑31 August in Ladakh, making it the first UT to complete the exercise.
• Option A is Incorrect because Delhi already conducts its own census but is not the first UT for the 2027 self‑enumeration.
• Option B is Incorrect because Chandigarh is not mentioned in the announcement.
• Option D is Incorrect because Puducherry is not part of the self‑enumeration schedule.

national_questions.qe: The free online coaching scheme announced by Prime Minister Narendra Modi targets which category of students?
national_questions.qh: प्रधानमंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी द्वारा घोषित मुफ्त ऑनलाइन कोचिंग योजना किस वर्ग के छात्रों को लक्षित करती है?
oe: Students from poor and middle‑class families
oh: गरीब और मध्य‑वर्गीय परिवारों के छात्र
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the scheme is intended for students from poor and middle‑class families to reduce their financial burden for competitive‑exam preparation.
• Option A is Incorrect as the scheme does not focus on affluent families.
• Option C is Incorrect because the announcement does not limit the benefit to rural areas.
• Option D is Incorrect because the scheme is not restricted to urban students.

national_questions.qe: Under the All India Radio code of conduct, criticism of which entity is expressly prohibited?
national_questions.qh: ऑल इंडिया रेडियो कोड के तहत किस इकाई की आलोचना पर स्पष्ट रूप से प्रतिबंध है?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the AIR code specifically bars criticism of friendly countries, along with attacks on religions, obscenity, contempt of court, etc.
• Option A is Incorrect because criticism of domestic political parties is not mentioned in the code.
• Option B is Incorrect because the code does not forbid criticism of foreign governments in general, only of friendly nations.
• Option D is Incorrect because the code bans attacks on religions or communities, not a separate category of religious leaders.

national_questions.qe: What nuclear power generation capacity has the Government of India targeted to achieve by the year 2047?
national_questions.qh: भारत सरकार ने वर्ष 2047 तक किस मात्रा में परमाणु ऊर्जा क्षमता हासिल करने का लक्ष्य निर्धारित किया है?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because Prime Minister Narendra Modi announced a target of 100 GW nuclear capacity by 2047 during the Independence Day celebrations.
• Option B is Incorrect as no official statement mentions 150 GW.
• Option C is Incorrect; the target is not 200 GW.
• Option D is Incorrect; 250 GW is not part of the announced plan.

national_questions.qe: Which mission has been launched under ‘Raksha Shakti’ to boost indigenous defence technology?
national_questions.qh: 'रक्षा शक्ति' के तहत स्वदेशी रक्षा प्रौद्योगिकी को बढ़ावा देने के लिए कौन सी मिशन शुरू की गई है?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the government announced ‘Mission Sudarshan Chakra’ as part of its effort to become a global supplier of next‑gen defence technology.
• Option A is Incorrect; Mission Shakti refers to the space launch programme.
• Option C is Incorrect; Mission Vayu is not an announced defence initiative.
• Option D is Incorrect; Mission Agni is a series of ballistic missiles, not the new mission referenced.

national_questions.qe: Which UN Security Council resolution was cited as being violated by the attacks on UAE vessels in the Strait of Hormuz?
national_questions.qh: संयुक्त राष्ट्र सुरक्षा परिषद के किस प्रस्ताव को खाड़ी में यूएई जहाज़ों पर हुए हमलों द्वारा उल्लंघित कहा गया?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the attacks were said to breach UN Security Council Resolution 2817, which re‑affirms freedom of navigation in the Strait of Hormuz.
• Option B is Incorrect because Resolution 242 pertains to the Middle‑East peace process, not maritime security.
• Option C is Incorrect because Resolution 678 relates to the cease‑fire in the Gulf War of 1991.
• Option D is Incorrect because Resolution 1973 concerns the no‑fly zone over Libya.

national_questions.qe: Which ministry is the nodal agency for implementing the Prime Minister Internship Scheme (PMIS)?
national_questions.qh: प्रधानमंत्री इंटर्नशिप स्कीम (PMIS) को लागू करने के लिए कौन सा मंत्रालय मुख्य एजेंसी है?
oe: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the PM Internship Scheme is administered by the Ministry of Corporate Affairs as per the official announcement.
• Option A is Incorrect; the Ministry of Skill Development assists in skill‑mapping but is not the nodal agency.
• Option C is Incorrect; the Ministry of Human Resource Development (now Ministry of Education) is unrelated to this scheme.

national_questions.qe: The MMDR Amendment Bill, 2026 seeks uniformity in taxation of which sector?
national_questions.qh: MMDR संशोधन विधेयक, 2026 किस क्षेत्र के कराधान में समानता लाने का लक्ष्य रखता है?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the Mines and Minerals (Development and Regulation) Amendment Bill aims to bring certainty and uniformity in mineral taxation.
• Option A is Incorrect; coal mining is covered under separate legislation.
• Option B is Incorrect; oil and gas are regulated by the Hydrocarbon sector laws, not MMDR.
• Option D is Incorrect; renewable energy projects fall under the Ministry of New & Renewable Energy, not MMDR.

national_questions.qe: The Mines and Minerals (Development and Regulation) Amendment Bill, 2026 seeks to amend which existing Act?
national_questions.qh: माइन्स एंड मिनरल्स (डेवलपमेंट एंड रेगुलेशन) संशोधन विधेयक, 2026 किस मौजूदा अधिनियम में संशोधन करने का प्रस्ताव रखता है?
oe: The Mines and Minerals (Development and Regulation) Act, 1957
The Mineral Conservation and Development Act, 1972
The Mining and Minerals Regulation Act, 2005
oh: माइन्स एंड मिनरल्स (डेवलपमेंट एंड रेगुलेशन) अधिनियम, 1957
national_questions.e: • Option A is Correct because the 2026 Amendment Bill is introduced to amend the Mines and Minerals (Development and Regulation) Act, 1957, the primary legislation governing mining in India. • Option B is Incorrect because the Mineral Conservation and Development Act, 1972 is a different statute. • Option C is Incorrect because the National Mineral Policy is a policy document, not an Act. • Option D is Incorrect because there is no Mining and Minerals Regulation Act, 2005.

national_questions.qe: Under which scheme did the Ministry of Heavy Industries receive 20 bids for sintered rare earth permanent magnet manufacturing in 2026?
national_questions.qh: 2026 में सेंटर्ड रेयर अर्थ स्थायी चुंबक (सिंटरड) निर्माण के लिए भारी उद्योग मंत्रालय ने 20 बिड किस योजना के तहत प्राप्त किए?
oe: Scheme to Promote Manufacturing of Sintered Rare Earth Permanent Magnets
Scheme for Promotion of Advanced Materials
Make in India Initiative for Rare Earths
oh: सिंटरड रेयर अर्थ स्थायी चुंबक निर्माण को प्रोत्साहित करने की योजना
उन्नत सामग्री को प्रोत्साहित करने की योजना
रेयर अर्थ्स के लिए मेक इन इंडिया पहल

national_questions.qe: Which Union Territory is slated to be the first to implement the Digital Rupee for Direct Benefit Transfer under the PM Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana?
national_questions.qh: कौन सा केंद्र शासित प्रदेश डिजिटल रुपे को पीएम गरीब कल्याण अन्न योजना के तहत सीधे लाभ हस्तांतरण (DBT) के लिए प्रथम लागू करेगा?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the Government announced that Chandigarh will be the first Union Territory to roll out the Central Bank Digital Currency (e₹) for DBT under PMGKAY.
• Option A is Incorrect because Delhi, though a Union Territory, was not selected for the pilot.
• Option C is Incorrect as Puducherry is not mentioned in the rollout plan.
• Option D is Incorrect; Lakshadweep is not part of the initial implementation.

national_questions.qe: Which of the following sectors is NOT among the 12 priority sectors identified by NITI Aayog for making India a global manufacturing hub?
national_questions.qh: निति आयोग द्वारा भारत को वैश्विक विनिर्माण केंद्र बनाने हेतु निर्धारित 12 प्राथमिक क्षेत्रों में से निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा क्षेत्र शामिल नहीं है?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the NITI Aayog report lists automobiles, pharmaceuticals, defense & drones, etc., but tourism is absent.
• Option A is Incorrect; automobiles are one of the highlighted sectors.
• Option B is Incorrect; pharmaceuticals are explicitly mentioned.
• Option D is Incorrect; defense and drones are part of the priority list.

national_questions.qe: Under which government initiative is India promoting indigenous chip design, fabrication and AI model development?
national_questions.qh: भारत में चिप डिज़ाइन, फ़ैब्रिकेशन और स्वदेशी AI मॉडल विकसित करने के लिए किस सरकारी पहल को प्रमुख माना जाता है?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the Government launched the India Semiconductor Mission to build capabilities in chip design, fabrication and AI.
• Option B is Incorrect; Make in India is a broader manufacturing scheme, not specific to semiconductors.
• Option C is Incorrect; Digital India focuses on digital services, not chip manufacturing.
• Option D is Incorrect; Startup India encourages entrepreneurship, not the semiconductor ecosystem.

national_questions.qe: Which ministry releases the monthly export data for India?
national_questions.qh: भारत का मासिक निर्यात डेटा किस मंत्रालय द्वारा जारी किया जाता है?
oe: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the Department of Commerce under the Ministry of Commerce and Industry publishes the monthly export‑import data (including the July 2026 figure of US$ 80.14 billion). 
• Option B is Incorrect because the Finance Ministry handles fiscal policy, not export statistics. 
• Option C is Incorrect because the External Affairs Ministry deals with diplomatic matters, not trade data. 
• Option D is Incorrect because the Statistics Ministry compiles data but the official release is under Commerce.

national_questions.qe: Which United Nations body attributed the Red Fort suicide car bombing to Al‑Qaida in the Indian Subcontinent?
national_questions.qh: रेड फोर्ट आत्मघाती कार बम विस्फोट को अल‑कायदा इन द इंडियन सबकॉन्टिनेंट से जोड़ने वाला संयुक्त राष्ट्र का कौन‑सा निकाय था?
oe: UN Office on Drugs and Crime
oh: संयुक्त राष्ट्र मादक पदार्थ एवं अपराध कार्यालय
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the UNSC’s Analytical Support and Sanctions Monitoring Team linked the Red Fort attack to AQIS. 
• Option B is Incorrect; the General Assembly does not issue such analytical attributions. 
• Option C is Incorrect; the Human Rights Council focuses on rights violations, not terrorist attribution. 
• Option D is Incorrect; UNODC deals with drugs and crime, not strategic terrorism assessments.

national_questions.qe: Which of the following energy sectors is NOT mentioned in India's current energy expansion strategy?
national_questions.qh: भारत की वर्तमान ऊर्जा विस्तार रणनीति में निम्नलिखित में से कौन‑सा ऊर्जा क्षेत्र उल्लेखित नहीं है?
national_questions.e:

• Option A is Incorrect; renewable energy is a key pillar of the plan. 
• Option B is Incorrect; nuclear power expansion is explicitly referenced. 
• Option C is Incorrect; coal remains part of the energy mix in the narrative.

national_questions.qe: What was the percentage growth in cumulative merchandise exports during April‑July 2026‑27 over the same period in 2025‑26?
national_questions.qh: अप्रैल‑जुलाई 2026‑27 में कुल वस्तु निर्यात में 2025‑26 की तुलना में प्रतिशत वृद्धि क्या थी?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the data states that merchandise exports grew by 17.04% in the April‑July 2026‑27 window. 
• Option A is Incorrect; 13.16% refers to overall export growth (merchandise + services). 
• Option C is Incorrect; 12.79% pertains to non‑petroleum exports, not total merchandise. 
• Option D is Incorrect; 19.6% is the year‑on‑year jump in July‑only merchandise shipments, not the April‑July cumulative figure.

national_questions.qe: Which statutory body was empowered by the National Co-operative Development Corporation (Amendment) Bill, 2026 to undertake industrial activities and provide loans directly to co-operatives?
national_questions.qh: कौन सी वैधानिक संस्था को राष्ट्रीय सहकारी विकास निगम (संशोधन) बिल, 2026 द्वारा औद्योगिक गतिविधियों को संचालित करने और सहकारी संस्थाओं को सीधे ऋण प्रदान करने का अधिकार दिया गया है?
oe: Small Industries Development Bank of India (SIDBI)
National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development (NABARD)
oh: राष्ट्रीय कृषि एवं ग्रामीण विकास बैंक (NABARD)
national_questions.e: • Option A is Correct because the Bill amends the NCDC Act, 1962 to allow NCDC to undertake activities in industrial goods and to extend loans and grants directly to co‑operatives. • Option B is Incorrect because the Ministry of Agriculture is not the entity being amended. • Option C is Incorrect because SIDBI is a separate financial institution not mentioned in the amendment. • Option D is Incorrect because NABARD deals with agriculture and rural credit, not the cooperative sector under this Bill.

national_questions.qe: Which Indian minister announced the initiation of negotiations for a Preferential Trade Agreement with the Southern African Customs Union (SACU)?
national_questions.qh: कौन से भारतीय मंत्री ने दक्षिणी अफ्रीकी कस्टम्स यूनियन (SACU) के साथ प्रेफरेंशियल ट्रेड एग्रीमेंट की बातचीत की शुरुआत की घोषणा की?
national_questions.e: • Option B is Correct because Union Minister Piyush Goyal, head of the Ministry of Commerce & Industry, said India and SACU have signed the Terms of Reference to start negotiations for a PTA. • Option A is Incorrect because the Finance Minister was not the announcing authority. • Option C is Incorrect because the External Affairs Minister was not involved in this trade‑agreement announcement. • Option D is Incorrect because the Home Minister does not handle international trade negotiations.

national_questions.qe: What is the total financial outlay of the Vibrant Villages Programme‑II approved by the Central Government?
national_questions.qh: वाइब्रेंट विलेजेज प्रोग्राम‑II के कुल वित्तीय खर्च की राशि क्या है?

• Option B is Incorrect as the outlay is higher than ₹5,000 crore.

national_questions.qe: What is the name of India's first comprehensive National Counter Terrorism Policy and Strategy?
national_questions.qh: भारत की पहली व्यापक राष्ट्रीय आतंकवाद विरोधी नीति और रणनीति का नाम क्या है?

national_questions.qe: Which body is proposed to be set up under the Tribunals Reforms Bill, 2026 to oversee selections and functioning of tribunals?
national_questions.qh: ट्रिब्यूनल सुधार बिल, 2026 के तहत कौन सा निकाय स्थापित किया जाएगा जो ट्रिब्यूनलों की चयन प्रक्रिया और कार्यप्रणाली की देखरेख करेगा?

• Option A is Incorrect; the Supreme Court Judicial Council is not mentioned in the Bill.

national_questions.qe: Which court cancelled the OBC certificates issued under the OBC‑A and OBC‑B classifications in West Bengal?
national_questions.qh: वेस्ट बंगाल में OBC‑A और OBC‑B वर्गीकरण के तहत जारी किए गए OBC प्रमाणपत्रों को किस अदालत ने रद्द किया?

• Option A is Incorrect; the Supreme Court did not pass this order.
• Option B is Incorrect; the Delhi High Court was not involved.

national_questions.qe: Which Government of India scheme has an outlay of ₹10,000 crore to promote manufacturing across the container ecosystem?
national_questions.qh: कौन सी भारत सरकार की योजना कंटेनर इकोसिस्टम में निर्माण को बढ़ावा देने के लिए ₹10,000 करोड़ का बजट रखती है?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the Container Manufacturing Assistance Scheme (CMAS) was announced with a ₹10,000 crore outlay to boost container manufacturing, technology development and employment, and is administered by the Ministry of Shipping.

• Option C is Incorrect because the National Maritime Development Programme is a broader maritime policy without the specified ₹10,000 crore allocation.
• Option D is Incorrect; Make in India is a general manufacturing push and does not earmark ₹10,000 crore for containers.

national_questions.qe: The Rail Coach Factory in Kapurthala will export its first rake of LHB coaches to which country?
national_questions.qh: कपूरथला स्थित रेल कोच फैक्ट्री अपनी पहली एलएचबी कोच रेक किस देश को निर्यात करेगी?
national_questions.e:

national_questions.qe: Which constitutional schedule is amended to change the name of the state Kerala to Keralam?

national_questions.qe: The Joint Parliamentary Committee (JPC) constituted to scrutinize the Foreign Contribution (Regulation) Amendment Bill, 2026, consists of how many members from the Lok Sabha?
national_questions.qh: विदेशी योगदान (नियमन) संशोधन विधेयक, 2026 की जांच के लिए गठित संयुक्त संसदीय समिति (JPC) में लोकसभा के कितने सदस्य शामिल हैं?

national_questions.qe: The National Co-operative Development Corporation (Amendment) Bill, 2026, empowers NCDC to undertake activities in which sector?

national_questions.qe: One of the key objectives of the Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises Development (Amendment) Bill, 2026 is to:

national_questions.qe: What is the core strategy framework introduced under the Anemia Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan Operational Guidelines?
national_questions.qh: अनीमिया मुक्त भारत अभियान परिचालन दिशानिर्देशों के तहत शुरू की गई मुख्य रणनीति ढांचा क्या है?

national_questions.qe: What is the financial outlay approved for the newly launched Container Manufacturing Assistance Scheme (CMAS)?
national_questions.qh: हाल ही में शुरू की गई कंटेनर विनिर्माण सहायता योजना (CMAS) के लिए स्वीकृत वित्तीय परिव्यय कितना है?

national_questions.qe: Under which specific scheme of the National Green Hydrogen Mission has a 30 KTPA green hydrogen production capacity been recently awarded for the refining sector?
national_questions.qh: राष्ट्रीय हरित हाइड्रोजन मिशन की किस विशिष्ट योजना के तहत रिफाइनिंग क्षेत्र के लिए हाल ही में 30 KTPA हरित हाइड्रोजन उत्पादन क्षमता आवंटित की गई है?

oh: गार्डन रीच शिपबिल्डर्स एंड इंजीनियर्स (GRSE), कोलकाता

national_questions.qe: Who has been selected for the post of Vice-Chancellor at the Atal Bihari Vajpayee Institute of Public Service and Innovation (AIPSI) in Mauritius?
national_questions.qh: मॉरीशस स्थित अटल बिहारी वाजपेयी इंस्टीट्यूट ऑफ पब्लिक सर्विस एंड इनोवेशन (AIPSI) में कुलपति के पद के लिए किसे चुना गया है?
